# IF-004 — Payment status webhook

[Landscape and catalog](../../README.md) · [Catalog source](../../catalog/catalog.json)

## Authentication

Verify the vendor HMAC signature and reject timestamps outside the replay window.

## Reliability and failure handling

Return 2xx after durable enqueue; deduplicate by eventId. Vendor retries non-2xx responses.
